proof:
Siblings used: mcm_lp_holder_bound (HB), mcm_exp_neg_integral_ftc (FTC), mcm_annulus_integration_by_parts (IBP). (GF): for every n > 0, ℓ, V, μ_V is finite on compact sets, dim T_xV = n μ_V-a.e., x ↦ p_{T_xV} is μ_V-a.e. strongly measurable. (UI): for n > 0, ℓ, V, open U, H with V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H, ξ, and 0 < σ ≤ ρ with B_ρ(ξ) ⊆ U, e_ξ(τ) := τ^{-(n+1)}∫_{B_τ(ξ)}⟨x−ξ, H⟩dμ_V is integrable on (σ, ρ], w_ξ := q_ξ/|x−ξ|ⁿ is μ_V-integrable on B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ), and a_ξ(ρ) − a_ξ(σ) = ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)}w_ξ dμ_V + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}e_ξ, where a_ξ(t) := μ_V(B_t(ξ))/tⁿ.
Assume (GF), (UI). Fix n > 0, ℓ, V, open U, H with V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H, p > n with H ∈ L^p_loc(U), ξ, R > 0 with B_R(ξ) ⊆ U, and Λ with A := (R^{p−n}∫_{B_R(ξ)}|H|^p dμ)^{1/p} ≤ κΛ, κ := lpKappa n p = (p−n)/(4p), μ := μ_V. By (GF), μ is finite on compact sets. Write a, e, w for a_ξ, e_ξ, w_ξ (w ≥ 0), D(s, t) := ∫_{B_t(ξ)∖B_s(ξ)}w dμ ≥ 0 and θ := 1 − n/p.
1. Constants. p > n ≥ 1 gives p > 1, κ > 0 and θ ∈ (0, 1). A ≥ 0 (a real power of the nonnegative number R^{p−n}∫|H|^p), so Λ ≥ A/κ ≥ 0. B_R(ξ) is compact and contained in U, so H ∈ L^p(μ⌞B_R(ξ)).
2. (4.2–4.3, Hölder.) For τ ∈ (0, R], HB gives |e(τ)| ≤ (A/R)(τ/R)^{−n/p}(1 + a(τ)) ≤ k(τ)(1 + a(τ)), where k(τ) := (κΛ/R)(τ/R)^{−n/p}, because A ≤ κΛ, (τ/R)^{−n/p} ≥ 0 and 1 + a(τ) ≥ 1.
3. Put F₀(τ) := e(τ)/(1 + a(τ)). For τ ∈ (0, R], 1 + a(τ) ≥ 1, |F₀(τ)| ≤ k(τ) and e(τ) = F₀(τ)(1 + a(τ)).
4. Integrability (4.5). Since −n/p > −1, k is integrable on (0, R], and for ρ ∈ (0, R], ∫_{(0,ρ]}k = (κΛ/R)R^{n/p}∫_0^ρ τ^{−n/p}dτ = (κΛ/R)R^{n/p}ρ^θ/θ = κΛ(p/(p−n))(ρ/R)^θ = (Λ/4)(ρ/R)^θ (here the corrected κ is used: κp/(p−n) = 1/4). τ ↦ μ(B_τ(ξ)) is nondecreasing (finite measures of increasing balls), so a is Borel on (0, ∞); by (UI) with radii R/(k+1) ≤ R, e is integrable, hence a.e.-strongly measurable, on each (R/(k+1), R], so on (0, R] = ⋃_k (R/(k+1), R]. Hence F₀ is a.e.-strongly measurable on (0, R] and dominated by k, so F₀ is integrable on (0, R] and ∫_{(0,ρ]}|F₀| ≤ (Λ/4)(ρ/R)^θ for ρ ∈ (0, R].
5. (4.5.) Define F(ρ) := exp(−∫_{(0,ρ]}F₀) for all ρ. For ρ ∈ (0, R] let s := −∫_{(0,ρ]}F₀; then |s| ≤ (Λ/4)(ρ/R)^θ ≤ (Λ/2)(ρ/R)^θ, so e^{−(Λ/2)(ρ/R)^θ} ≤ F(ρ) = e^s ≤ e^{(Λ/2)(ρ/R)^θ}. Moreover (ρ/R)^θ ≤ 1, so |s| ≤ Λ/4, and by the mean value theorem |e^s − 1| = |s|e^{ζ} for some ζ between 0 and s, whence |F(ρ) − 1| ≤ e^{|s|}|s| ≤ e^{Λ/4}(Λ/4)(ρ/R)^θ ≤ e^{Λ/2}(Λ/2)(ρ/R)^θ = (e^{Λ/2}/2)Λ(ρ/R)^θ. This is the first conjunct.
6. By FTC with g := F₀: F'(τ) := −F₀(τ)F(τ) is integrable on (0, R] and F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]}F' for all 0 ≤ σ ≤ t ≤ R.
7. (4.4, 4.7.) Let 0 < σ ≤ ρ ≤ R. For σ ≤ s ≤ t ≤ ρ, 0 < s and B_t(ξ) ⊆ B_R(ξ) ⊆ U, so (UI) gives a(t) − a(s) = D(s, t) + ∫_{(s,t]}e; (UI) with (σ, ρ) gives integrability of e on (σ, ρ] and of w on B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ). With step 6 (F' integrable on (σ, ρ] ⊆ (0, R], F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]}F' on [σ, ρ]), IBP applied to (μ, ξ, w, a, e, F, F', σ, ρ) gives: F(|·−ξ|)w is μ-integrable on B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ) and F(ρ)a(ρ) − F(σ)a(σ) = I(σ, ρ) + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}(Fe + F'a), where I(σ, ρ) := ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)}F(|x−ξ|)w(x)dμ. For τ ∈ (σ, ρ] ⊆ (0, R], by step 3, F(τ)e(τ) + F'(τ)a(τ) = F(τ)F₀(τ)(1 + a(τ)) − F₀(τ)F(τ)a(τ) = F₀(τ)F(τ) = −F'(τ). Hence ∫_{(σ,ρ]}(Fe + F'a) = −∫_{(σ,ρ]}F' = −(F(ρ) − F(σ)) by step 6 at t = ρ, and therefore (F(ρ)a(ρ) + (F(ρ) − 1)) − (F(σ)a(σ) + (F(σ) − 1)) = I(σ, ρ).
8. (G.) For x ∈ B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ), |x−ξ| ∈ (σ, ρ] ⊆ (0, R], and (|x−ξ|/R)^θ ≤ 1, so by step 5 and Λ ≥ 0, e^{−Λ} ≤ e^{−Λ/2} ≤ F(|x−ξ|) ≤ e^{Λ/2} ≤ e^{Λ}. Multiplying by w(x) ≥ 0 and integrating (both integrable by step 7): e^{−Λ}D(σ, ρ) ≤ I(σ, ρ) ≤ e^{Λ}D(σ, ρ). Define G(σ, ρ) := I(σ, ρ)/D(σ, ρ) if D(σ, ρ) ≠ 0 and 1 otherwise. If D(σ, ρ) > 0, G(σ, ρ) ∈ [e^{−Λ}, e^{Λ}] and G·D = I; if D(σ, ρ) = 0, then I(σ, ρ) = 0, G(σ, ρ) = 1 ∈ [e^{−Λ}, e^{Λ}] (Λ ≥ 0) and G·D = 0 = I. With step 7 this is the second conjunct (4.7) for 0 < σ ≤ ρ ≤ R.
9. (4.8.) For 0 < σ ≤ ρ ≤ R the difference in step 7 equals G(σ, ρ)D(σ, ρ) ≥ 0 (G > 0, D ≥ 0), so ρ ↦ F(ρ)a(ρ) + (F(ρ) − 1) is nondecreasing on (0, R]. F and G depend only on the data fixed above, which proves LpMonotonicity. ∎

F₀ := e/(1 + a) is integrable on (0, R] with ∫_{(0,ρ]}|F₀| ≤ (Λ/4)(ρ/R)^θ (corrected κ)
FTC + IBP with Fe + F'a = F F₀ = −F' give (Fa + F − 1)(ρ) − (Fa + F − 1)(σ) = ∫F(|x−ξ|)w dμ
e^{−Λ}D ≤ ∫F(|x−ξ|)w ≤ e^{Λ}D gives G ∈ [e^{−Λ}, e^{Λ}]; G·D ≥ 0 gives monotonicity on (0, R]
